prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished transparent PNG game sprite sheet of chibi Arona from Blue Archive, using the attached character strictly as a design reference. Each cell contains the SAME full-body 2.5-head-tall chibi, same size and registration: head centered at x=50% of its cell, feet at y=90%, whole halo inside y=6%, broad clear padding. Left frame: neutral soft smile, visible blue eye open, hands together in front. Right frame: identical body pose and contours, visible eye gently closed for a blink; only eyelid changes. Preserve pale ice-blue bob hair, long fringe covering one eye, tiny side braid with bow, white bunny-ear head bow, cyan floating halo, blue-white sailor outfit with white collar and bow, white pleated skirt, white shoes. Soft cel shading, crisp delicate blue outlines, rounded kawaii mobile-game rendering, cohesive pastel cyan/white palette. Wholesome fully clothed character. No weapon/umbrella, no scenery, no floor, no shadows outside sprite, no extra figures. Real transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard drawing. This is an animation sheet: matching alignment and near-identical frame silhouettes are essential.
